      issue_number: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}

      - name: Authenticate status callbacks
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        env:
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
          OMGITHUB_ORIGIN: ${{ vars.OMGITHUB_ORIGIN || 'https://omgithub.com' }}

          /usr/bin/time -p node --input-type=module <<'NODE'

              console.log(`::add-mask::${token}`);
              appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_ENV, `OMGITHUB_CALLBACK_TOKEN=${token}\n`);
              break;

              if (attempt === 7) throw error;

        continue-on-error: true

          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
          OMGITHUB_ORIGIN: ${{ vars.OMGITHUB_ORIGIN || 'https://omgithub.com' }}

# New player guide

Everything you need for your first hour. Five minutes to read, and you can skip to the [controls](#controls) if you just want the keys.

### 1\. Get an account

Accounts are free. [Register here](/register), then remember the account name and password — that's what you type into the client, not your character's name. Registering also makes your first hero, so there's nothing else to set up.

### 2\. Get into the world

Grab the [Windows or Linux client](/downloads) (one zip, no installer). Log in with your **account** details, then pick your hero — or make another from the **New Hero** screen.

### 3\. Your first steps

You'll wake in a temple. That's a **protection zone**: nothing can hurt you while you stand in one, so it's a safe place to get your bearings and the place you return to if you die.

Walk outside and find something small to fight. Attack by **clicking a creature**; you'll keep swinging until one of you stops. Watch the health bar under its name rather than your own, and step back into town when your own bar looks thin — monsters won't follow you into a protection zone. When something dies it leaves a corpse: press **F** next to it and you'll take what's inside. Sell the junk to the town's shopkeepers, keep anything you can wear.

Everything you kill earns **experience**, and experience raises your **level** — see below.

### Controls

The essentials first — you can play the whole first hour with these:

### Getting around

**Arrow keys** walk, one tile at a time.  
**Click the ground** to path there automatically.  
**Ctrl \+ arrow** turns without stepping.  
**Right-click** anything to use it — doors, ladders, levers, chests.

### Fighting

**Click a creature** to target and attack it.  
**Shift \+ click** follows it instead.  
**1 – 0** fire your action bar.  
**Esc** opens the menu (settings, log out).

### Loot & bags

**F** or **Space** loots the nearest corpse.  
**Q** toggles quick-loot and item filters.  
**I** opens your backpack.  
**Ctrl \+ click** picks an item up off the ground.

### Your character

**C** or **K** — equipment and skills.  
**R** — your rank band.  
**T** — the Fateweave.  
**M** — the map. **L** — the job board.

### The wider world

**N** — dungeons. **P** — professions.  
**U** — marketplace. **O** — reputation.  
**H** — your settlement. **Y** — hall of firsts.  
**J** — screenshot.

### 4\. How you actually get stronger

This world grows you by **experience levels**. Every kill and every job-board task earns experience; gather enough and you rise a level. Each level lifts your health, mana and carrying capacity, and gear, doors and spells ask for a level before they let you in.

Levels fall into **rank bands** on the same ladder everyone climbs:

**E** 1-8 · **D** 9-20 · **C** 21-40 · **B** 41-70 · **A** 71-110 · **S** 111-160 · **SS** 161-220 · **SSS** 221+

Your band sets how deep into the Fateweave you can reach and which windows the client opens for you, and monsters carry a rank on the same ladder, so you can size up a fight before you start it.

Dying costs you some **experience**, and a bad death can cost a level. Blessings soften the loss.

Spending happens in the **Fateweave** — a large tree of passive nodes. Every level adds a little to your point budget, up to the full build once you reach the SSS band, and you decide what your character actually becomes. There's a full walkthrough on [the Fateweave page](/fateweave) and the numbers on [the progression page](/progression).

### 5\. Where you'll be playing

This is **Arethan**, a small showcase world. You wake in its temple, marked on the map, and the Arkenfall Temple stands a few steps west, inside the hall beside you. Around them: open fields, farmsteads with tilled plots, a crop garden in the south-east and the paths between them. Press **M** in-game for the live map, which fills in as you explore.

![Map of Arethan, with the temple where new heroes wake and the Arkenfall Temple marked](/static/arethan-map.webp?v=1794542635)

### Getting unstuck

**The client won't connect.** Some workplace and campus networks block the game's address. The client already falls back automatically, so try again once; if it still fails, you're most likely behind a firewall that won't let it out.

**Your login is refused.** Log in with your **account** name, not your character's name — that catches almost everyone at least once.

**You died and lost experience.** That's the price of a death on this world, and sometimes it costs a level. Walk back out and earn it again.

**Something's clearly broken.** Tell us in [Discord](https://discord.gg/dkx22rY3N9) — alpha means bug reports genuinely change what gets fixed next.

### Where to go next

The [wiki](https://wiki.arkenfall.net) goes deeper on everything here, [abilities](/abilities) and [magic](/magic) cover what you can cast, and [dungeons and rifts](/dungeons) are where you'll be heading once you've found your feet. Good luck out there.

# Abilities

Magic in Arkenfall isn't a shop — it's a spellbook you **build**. Every ability is unlocked and grown on the [Fateweave](/fateweave), themed to your calling. There are no tiers to buy: an ability **deepens** the more you invest in it. (Live in the alpha build — abilities unlock and grow on the Fateweave.)

Incantations are in the **old tongue** — a grammar, not a word list, so a phrase can be half-guessed. sana heals, accende kindles, gela freezes, surge raises; power ladders magna then maxima.

### Universal

| Ability | Type | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Strike ictus | Physical | Your basic attack — always ready. |
| Mend sana | Heal | A quick self-heal. |
| Renew sana maxima | Heal | A deep heal for when it is serious. |
| Purge purga | Heal | Cleanse an affliction — poison, burning, curse and more. |
| Quicken cita | Support | A burst of haste. |
| Emberlight voca lumen | Support | Conjure light in the dark. |
| Godfall cade lumen | **Ultimate** | Call a pillar of light down on your foe, in your calling’s own element. Rank SSS. |

### Pyrewright — fire · death

Takes more from the Ark than it should, and pays for it. Kills leave **embers** that sharpen your spells — or give a minion up forever for a standing boon instead.

| Ability | Slot | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ember accende | Basic | A fast fire bolt. |
| Cinder Lance hasta ignea | Core | Pierces every foe in a line. |
| Pyre Nova rogus | Core | Erupts in flame around you. |
| Ashveil velum cineris | Defensive | A shroud of ash that absorbs a burst. |
| Immolate immola | Mastery | Sets a foe burning over time. |
| Soul Rend carpe animam | Mastery | Drains life — heals you for part of the damage. |
| Wither marce | Mastery | A curse that saps a foe's strength. |
| Raise Bonewalker surge ossa | Signature | Raise the dead to fight for you. |
| Raise Bonewarden surge ossa magna | Signature | A heavier servant that genuinely tanks. |
| Raise Marrow Archer surge sagitta | Signature | A bowman of bone; its arrows pin foes in place. |
| Raise Ash Acolyte surge cinis | Signature | A caster that throws fire splashing the whole pack. |
| Command: Guard custodi ossa | Order | The warband fights what you select, then whatever attacks you. The default. |
| Command: Hold mane ossa | Order | Each minion holds its post and fights only what it can reach from there. |
| Command: Unleash solve ossa | Order | Defends you first, otherwise hunts the nearest foe close by. |
| Hellcore cor inferni | **Ultimate** | A devastating eruption. |

### Tidecaller — frost · storm

Asks, and is answered. Casting an element charges it; casting a **different** one next spends the charge for a stronger hit. Rotation beats mashing.

| Ability | Slot | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rime gela | Basic | Chills and slows a target. |
| Rime Shards nimbus gelu | Core | A cone of freezing shards. |
| Frost Nova orbis gelu | Core | Freezes foes around you. |
| Sanctuary tege | Defensive | A shield that absorbs a burst. |
| Rejuvenate sana magna | Defensive | Healing that mends over time. |
| Tidecall voca undam | Defensive | Heals allies around you. |
| Arc Bolt fulmen | Mastery | Energy that leaps between foes. |
| Storm Rend tempestas | Mastery | A wave of raw energy. |
| Thornweave spinae | Mastery | Roots and rends a foe. |
| Gale ventus | Mastery | A gust that knocks foes back. |
| Blight tabes | Mastery | Creeping poison over time. |
| Glacier hiems aeterna | **Ultimate** | A killing winter. |

### Duskwalker — shadow · venom · bow

Slips past it unnoticed. Crits and kills stack **Momentum**; striking out of the shadows dumps the whole stack into one blow. Pays Focus, not mana — always ready for one burst, never for three.

| Ability | Slot | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Piercing Shot transfige | Basic | A shot that pierces a line. |
| Splitshot sagittae | Core | Fire at several foes at once. |
| Snipe collima | Core | A long aim for a heavy critical. |
| Shadowstep gradus umbrae | Defensive | Blink a short distance. |
| Ghostwalk vela umbra | Defensive | Vanish briefly from sight. |
| Rain of Arrows pluvia sagittae | Mastery | A volley across an area. |
| Venom Bolt venenum | Mastery | A poisoned shot that stacks. |
| Ambush insidiae | Signature | Strike from the shadows — spends Momentum. |
| Quarry praeda | **Ultimate** | Mark a foe and run it down. |

### Ironsworn — steel · fury

Stands against it. Swear one standing **oath** — Bulwark, Berserk or Warcry — and carry it until you swear another. Pays Fury, built by landing *and* taking blows, and bled away out of combat.

| Ability | Slot | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rend lacera | Basic | A wound that bleeds over time — free. |
| Cleave seca | Core | Strike all tiles ahead of you. |
| Whirlwind turbo | Core | Spin, striking everything adjacent. |
| Skullcrush frange | Core | A heavy blow that briefly stuns. |
| Iron Guard murus ferri | Defensive | Brace: raise your block and reflect. |
| Ground Slam quate terram | Mastery | Knock down nearby foes. |
| Warcry clamor | Signature | Rally allies — haste and resolve. |
| Bulwark vallum | Signature | Hold the line; damage taken is cut. |
| Undying indomitus | **Ultimate** | Spend Fury for a savage strike. |
| Worldbreaker rumpe mundum | **Ultimate** | Stop time, cut six slashes around your foe, then bring a sword of light down on it. Rank SS. |

### Ascendancy signatures

Each specialization ends in a signature ability, granted when you reach its capstone on the Fateweave:

| Ascendancy | Signature | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Necromancer | Raise Shade voca umbras | Raise a decaying shade to fight for you. |
| Emberlord | Firestorm tempestas ignis | Rain fire across a wide area. |
| Oracle | Foresight providentia | Periodically negate the next hit against you. |
| Rimewarden | Chain Lightning catena fulminis | Lightning that arcs between foes. |
| Warlord | Banner of War vexillum | Plant a banner that empowers your party. |
| Sentinel | Bulwark vallum | Become an immovable wall, reflecting damage. |
| Deadeye | Quarry praeda | Mark a foe; your hits on it ramp. |
| Nightblade | Deathmark nota mortis | Mark a foe for a single lethal strike. |

### The Necromancer's kit

Beyond its signature, the Necromancer learns two more rites from rank B, and keeps them even if it later binds Ash Monarch:

| Ability | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Raise Bone Colossus surge ossa maxima | One at a time, filling two warband slots: a slow giant that slams the ground around it. The warband's damage anchor, not its tank. |
| Raise the Fallen surge mortui | Fresh monster corpses nearby rise as Bonewalkers; whatever loot they held spills onto the ground. |

The full warband — ranks, slots, orders, minion gear and the Pyre’s sacrifices — is on the [wiki](https://wiki.arkenfall.net/Companions_and_Minions).
